_doc: New page: no old Notion text of its own. Every power, cooling or failure claim in the parent root's Reading and src/read/old/ (old root and four old children), with its verdict here.

rows.claim: Watts per chip: A100 400 W, H100 700 W, Blackwell up to 1,200 W, Blackwell Ultra 1,400 W, MI355X 1,400 W, MI455X up to 2,500 W
rows.verdict: verified (FACTS.md; NVIDIA blog Aug 22 2025; AMD data sheets)

rows.claim: Above about a kilowatt per chip air gives way to liquid; GB200 NVL72 and Ironwood liquid cooled
rows.verdict: verified in kind; the 'about a kilowatt' threshold is the root's framing, not sourced; this page argues from rack power and Q = m cp dT instead
verified (Google blog Apr 2025); whether it includes cooling unconfirmed
rows.where: s1 ladder, s3 table, Gigawatt planner

rows.claim: Llama 3 power swings of tens of megawatts

rows.verdict: owned by the root; linked in Further reading, not repeated

rows.claim: SemiAnalysis Vera Rubin NVL72 up to 7x tokens per MW vs GB300
rows.verdict: owned by the root (paywalled); referenced as 'section 8 of the parent page'

rows.claim: 419 interruptions in 54 days, about 78% hardware, faulty GPUs 148 (30.1%), HBM3 72 (17.2%)
rows.verdict: corrected: 148 of 419 is 35.3% (the paper's 30.1% is a misprint); GPU rows 268 of 419 = 64.0%. The root should change 30.1% to 35.3% (or say 'printed as 30.1%')

rows.claim: At that scale something fails every few hours; MFU measured between failures overstates throughput
Per gigawatt about 466,000 B200 (DGX B200 14.3 kW / 8 x PUE 1.2)
Energisation not fabrication is the 2027 constraint; 15 GW stranded; transformers 48-60 months; 66 GW US demand
rows.verdict: unconfirmed (secondary, originates in a social media post); dropped, as the root did

rows.claim: H.R. 9340 passed 417-3; Nvidia+Google grid-stress framework; SemiAnalysis 300 restrictions, 2.3 GW delayed
rows.verdict: unconfirmed (no primary source fetched); dropped, as the root did. The grid-stress idea is taught from the Microsoft paper instead

rows.claim: DSX Ready certification of power and cooling equipment (Sep 22 2026)
Project Suncatcher orbital TPUs; 10-year Treasury 5.17%; Anthropic-Akamai deal
rows.verdict: unconfirmed and not hardware teaching; dropped, as the root did

rows.claim: Vera Rubin modelled economics per utility gigawatt ($159.5B revenue)
rows.verdict: dropped: modelled business figures, paywalled; the per-gigawatt view is taught from vendor power figures

rows.claim: Liquid cooling from TPU v3; TPUs win on performance per watt because data movement dominates energy
rows.verdict: v3 liquid cooling verified (Jouppi et al. 2020); performance per watt shown as pJ/FLOP at peak (TPU v4 0.70 vs H100 0.71), so 'win' is not supported at peak; the data-movement argument is the memory_technology page's
verified (FACTS.md); H100 used here, consumer cards left to gpu_architecture
